answer: Count the cost of replication first. Copy a task once and a replay check catches it; copy it 50 times and the 50th costs the same as the first, which is why volume alone never prices a farm. Convert payouts into a 100-epoch vesting stream and the farm must fund 50 identities for 25 days before one coin lands. Draw auditors from a rotating pool so no seat can be bought twice. Last week a hollow cluster of 30 on our cedar deployment lost wharf access after two missed audits and paid 30 vesting streams for nothing.
